name: Amazon Connect Frontline Concierge Agent
description: Frontline omnichannel voice and chat agent in Amazon Connect responsible for identity verification, intent classification, and delegating specialised requests.

capabilities.name: Customer Identity & Intent Triage
capabilities.description: Resolves customer identity via Customer Profiles and classifies inbound contact intent.

capabilities.name: A2A Handoff Initiation
capabilities.description: Packaging dialogue context, propensity scores, and active contact session variables into standard A2A handoff contracts.
